auth: x-goog-api-key header (value from GEMINI_API_KEY; never stored)

rate_limit.backoff: Retry-After if given, else 2**attempt s; on 429, 5xx, transport errors

framing_observations.note: Short-input counts are reported as observed. A non-zero count for a one-character input is consistent with request framing, but its size is not assumed constant across inputs and nothing is subtracted from article counts.

cache_evidence.validation: every cache record checked against model, endpoint, request shape, date; article counts reproduce the pinned anchor
provenance_limitations: cache records predate cache schema 2: provider, text-identity, adapter-version and count-field fields were not recorded at measurement time and are not reconstructed; the records are trusted only because their article counts reproduce the anchor above
